summary: Connecting Adriatic marine biodiversity with visitor experiences and sustainable tourism.

body:
Photographs from the “Adriatic Sea Biodiversity” training workshop, held at Hotel Lero in Dubrovnik, Croatia, on 21 October 2021, within the EXCHANGE project.

The workshop connected tour operators and tourism guides with marine researchers to explore how knowledge of the Adriatic Sea can enrich visitor experiences. Presentations introduced the EXCHANGE project and Blue Pass, the Adriatic’s geographical and biological characteristics, and changes in marine biodiversity, including the arrival of non-native species.

The gallery captures speakers, participants and the workshop setting, alongside a view of Dubrovnik’s harbour and Aquarium entrance, linking the learning activities with the destination’s aquatic heritage.
